key_insight: By pairing a tetrahedral 3D color code with its Hadamard-transformed H-tetrahedral counterpart, the paper achieves complementary transversal non-Clifford gates and nearly universal logical operations via code switching.
engineering_relevance: This offers a fault-tolerant path to quantum circuits where magic-state-like operations and much of the entangling logic are implemented transversally, reducing overhead in scalable quantum hardware.
method: Use two 3D color-code encodings with complementary transversal gate sets.
Switch between encodings via bitwise Hadamard transforms and use a one-way transversal logical CNOT.
Complete universality with a pieceably fault-tolerant round-robin logical CZ between two H-tetrahedral codes plus Steane-type syndrome extraction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a construction and gate-level protocol, but no experimental data or numerical benchmarking results are given.
watch_item: Universal operation still depends on non-transversal Clifford entangling steps and additional syndrome-extraction infrastructure, which may limit practical overhead savings.
paper_title: Complementary 3D color codes for transversal quantum logic
